name: desktop-claude-code-mods
description: Mods for Claude Code in the Claude desktop app: a dashboard pane, bands above the prompt, panes next to the chat and guards

plugins.name: bro-cockpit
plugins.description: Dashboard: a pane next to the chat with overview, files, subagents, tool calls, context meter, errors, todos and project ideas, plus a git line above the prompt. Open with /cockpit.

plugins.name: secret-guard
plugins.description: Guard: stops Claude from writing API keys, tokens, private keys and passwords into files or shell commands. Works in the background, no screen.

plugins.name: branch-guard-band
plugins.description: Band above the prompt: red warning when you work directly on main or master. Only warns, blocks nothing.

plugins.name: env-band
plugins.description: Band above the prompt: shows the active environment (development, staging, production) from your .env files.

plugins.name: limit-band
plugins.description: Band above the prompt: how much of your 5-hour and 7-day usage limit is used and when it resets.

plugins.name: deadline-band
plugins.description: Band above the prompt: countdown to your project deadline. Set it with /deadline.

plugins.name: daily-band
plugins.description: Band above the prompt: today's working time, cost, turns and commits across all sessions.

plugins.name: prompt-library
plugins.description: Pane: save prompts once and reuse them in every project, with placeholders. Open with /prompts.

plugins.name: snippet-pane
plugins.description: Pane: save code snippets per project and insert them into the prompt box. Open with /snippets.

plugins.name: session-summary
plugins.description: Pane: a very short running summary of the session. Uses a few model tokens (Haiku). Open with /summary.

plugins.name: kanban-pane
plugins.description: Pane: a small Open / In progress / Done board per project. Open with /kanban, add cards with /card.

plugins.name: log-viewer
plugins.description: Pane: output of the last shell commands with errors highlighted. Open with /logs.

plugins.name: dependency-pane
plugins.description: Pane: your project's dependencies and which are outdated (npm). Open with /deps.

plugins.name: usage-pane
plugins.description: Pane: which skills, plugins and connectors you actually use, what is unused, and what each costs in context. Open with /toolusage.

plugins.name: permission-log
plugins.description: Pane: which permission prompts you allowed or declined, and a ready allow rule for the ones you always allow. Open with /permlog.
